notes: The Recreation and Park Commission's 1960 volume. Curated: the Diamond Heights namings (George Christopher, Walter A. Haas), Helen Wills and McCoppin Square field houses, the Hall of Flowers, Noble Collection and Rose Garden dedications, the Lincoln Park Japanese monument and McLaren Park's land acquisition.

coverage.remaining: Routine items (zoo, Fleishhacker, Camp Mather, Mission Park convenience station) not curated. Not placed: the Hunters Point Recreation Center dedication (June 4, 1960) and the Silver Tree Day Camp building (Stenmark Construction, $142,355), for want of a sure page; the Candlestick Park dedication plaque (no page).
